artists.source_line: The Angolan Dances Trip is an immersive cultural experience created by Lápis Eventos, led by Gabriel Cabinda, the producer behind the internationally recognized Angolan Dances Festival (Lisbon).

features.quote: Dance workshops (Kizomba, Semba, Kuduro & traditional dances)
features.rationale: The included list names dance workshops in several styles.

features.quote: Intensive training: 1 hour/day in small groups (1 instructor per 3 participants)
features.rationale: A daily intensive training course is described as part of the trip.

features.quote: Live music, backyard parties & street celebrations
features.rationale: Live music is listed as an included element of the trip.

features.quote: Includes accommodation, transport, activities & 2 meals per day
Includes accommodation, transport, activities & 2 meals per day
features.rationale: The package explicitly includes two meals per day.
Local transportation is included in the trip.
Desert camping is part of the Package 2 accommodation.
